summary: The interface exhibits critical contrast readability issues in the shortcuts section and vertical overflow clipping on 360x640 viewports.

issues.title: Footer text clipped by viewport
issues.description: Bottom status line overflows screen bounds and gets cut off vertically.
issues.evidence: The text 'Auto-saving to cloud · highlights marked 4' is sliced at the bottom edge.
issues.suggestion: Reduce card padding or vertical gaps to ensure all content fits within 640px.

issues.title: Insufficient shortcut section contrast
issues.description: Labels and keyboard shortcut glyphs inside the bottom panel fail readability contrast against the dark background.
issues.evidence: Labels 'Pause / resume', 'Mute microphone', 'Save take', and their associated kbd caps are barely legible.
issues.suggestion: Use brighter text tokens for muted labels and increase border/text contrast on kbd elements.
